content_metadata.description: A video featuring Dr. C demonstrating physics principles through experiments.

qAndA.answer: Dr. C uses a bed of nails.

narrativeProgression.description: Dr. C introduces the bed of nails and explains the concept of pressure.
Dr. C defines pressure as force per unit area.
Dr. C compares the pressure difference between lying on the floor and standing on one nail.
Dr. C explains how distributing her weight over many nails reduces the pressure on each individual nail.
Dr. C lies down on the bed of nails to demonstrate the principle.
